name: vnp-fold-ladder
description: The fold ladder (v5.1.2): the head's fold answers with no summary (the NIMBUSD_FOLD_FAULT seam, the device's PROVFAULT), the cycle walks to the next keyed provider, and the summary lands there. Rung failures are logged with their kind; no cycle fails and the owner hears nothing.

steps.say: The codeword for this conversation is QUINCE-41. Acknowledge it in one short sentence.
Note $i of a long working session. Reply in one short sentence acknowledging the note.

expect.log_not_regex: fold\(.*\): cycle failed|no summary in reply on

steps.say: Earlier in this conversation I told you a codeword. What was it? Answer with the codeword only.
